verdict.rationale: Highnote documents an 'interactive code explorer' and 'API Explorer' for executing calls, queries, and schema search in a Test environment, plus a full test environment replicating production for simulating transactions — supporting runnable-example exploration. However, no OpenAPI/Swagger spec is discoverable (probe returned 404s), and there's no direct evidence of embedded runnable code snippets per endpoint in the docs pages themselves. missing for 10: discoverable OpenAPI spec, direct evidence of inline runnable examples per API reference page, independent/hands-on confirmation of the Explorer's usability.
